problems.condition: Unit 3, Step 10, упр. 2, с. 134. Прочитай вопросы к басне и ответь на них.
steps: 1) A peasant had an apple tree.
2) The peasant decided to cut the tree down because it had no apples.
3) He took an axe and came up to the tree.
4) The sparrows and grasshoppers asked him not to cut the tree down.
5) The peasant didn't listen to them.
6) He found bees and honey in the tree.
7) He decided to keep the tree.
problems.answer: Ответы по сюжету: крестьянин, яблоня, топор, воробьи и кузнечики, пчёлы с мёдом

steps: I think the peasant lived in a simple wooden house with a small window and a big door.
There was a small garden near the house with an apple tree, berries, fruit and vegetables.
problems.answer: Простой деревянный дом и небольшой сад с яблоней, ягодами и овощами

problems.condition: Unit 3, Step 10, упр. 4, с. 134. Разыграй басню по ролям.
steps: Peasant: This tree has no apples. I'll cut it down.
Sparrows: Please, don't cut it down! We live here.
Grasshoppers: Don't cut the tree down! We sing here.
Peasant: Oh! There are bees and honey in the tree. I'll keep it!
problems.answer: Диалог крестьянина, воробьёв, кузнечиков и пчёл по сюжету басни

problems.condition: Unit 3, Step 10, упр. 6, с. 135. Расскажи по-английски «Сказку о глупом мышонке» Маршака.
steps: Mother Mouse ran away and came back with a duck. The duck began singing, but Little Mouse thought her voice was very loud.
Mother Mouse came back with a frog. The frog sang, but Little Mouse thought it was boring.
Mother Mouse came back with a horse, then with a pig, then with a hen — Little Mouse didn't like their songs.
At last Mother Mouse came back with a cat. The cat sang very softly, and Little Mouse liked it. When Mother Mouse came back, Little Mouse was not in bed.
problems.answer: Пересказ сказки: мама-мышь приводила утку, лягушку, лошадь, свинью, курицу и кошку
